column1: # PRISM Sample Patient Data — Feature Structure Reference
# This file contains 20 SYNTHETIC patients generated for demonstration purposes.
# All values are fabricated and do not represent any real individuals.
#   age_years          : age at index date (t0) in years
#   cci_total          : Charlson Comorbidity Index total score (5-year lookback)
#   Zones A/B → Low baseline ACMM risk (<30%)
#   Zones C/D → High baseline ACMM risk (≥30%)
#   dm_comp=1 supersedes dm=1 (set dm=0 when dm_comp=1)
#   metastatic=1 supersedes malignancy=1 (set malignancy=0 when metastatic=1)
